description: An oil-style painting of a dark-hulled steam and sail ship moored at a quay at dusk. A white flag with a red disc flies from a mast at the bow. Men in headbands and loose robes, and uniformed men in dark caps, handle thick ropes on the wooden dock, beside crates and barrels. A small junk-rigged boat sits on the left. The scene reads as mid-to-late 19th century. No visible text, frame or wounds.
